journey.name: Health Connect
journey.description: Connect Health Connect in Settings, take the weight it holds into the weight sheet, finish a workout and find it in Health Connect, then disconnect. The emulator has no watch, so the summary and the workout's page show no heart rate; with a watch syncing to Health Connect they would show its average and peak. Run on a phone in portrait on Android 14 or later, where Health Connect is part of the system; the emulator's Health Connect must be open once before (Settings > Security and privacy > Health Connect). Where a step cannot be verified without the Health Connect app, note it as not checked.

actions.action: Tap the "Settings" button on the Timer tab
Scroll to "Your data" and verify that it shows a "Health Connect" switch, off, saying "Save finished workouts and Lift sessions there too"
Tap the "Health Connect" switch
Verify that Health Connect's permission sheet opens, asking to write exercise and total calories burned and to read weight and heart rate, with Interval's privacy policy linked
Tap the privacy policy link and verify that Interval's "Privacy" page opens, with a "Health Connect" section; go back to the sheet
Allow all
Verify that the "Health Connect" switch is on and says "Finished workouts and Lift sessions are saved there"
Open Health Connect (Settings > Security and privacy > Health Connect > Data and access > Weight), add a weight entry of 82 kg for today, and return to Interval's Settings
Tap "Back", then the Timer tab's "Settings" button again, so Settings reads Health Connect afresh
Scroll to "Calories", tap "Body weight" (which reads its value in a pill), and verify that the sheet offers "Use Health Connect's: 82 kg"

Tap "Use Health Connect's: 82 kg" and verify that the weight reads 82, the button turns into a disabled "From Health Connect: 82 kg" without the sheet moving, and that "More weight" makes it 83 and offers "Use Health Connect's: 82 kg" again; tap that once more
Tap "Done" and verify that "Body weight" reads "82 kg"
Tap "Back"
Tap "Start workout", skip to the first rest with "Skip to next interval" twice, tap "End workout" and confirm
Verify that the summary says "Ended" and shows no "Heart rate" line (no watch recorded one)
Under "How was it?" tap "Hard" and type "Felt strong" in the note field

Tap "Done", then open Health Connect (Settings > Security and privacy > Health Connect > Data and access > Exercise) and verify that an Interval entry of high intensity interval training is listed for today, with segments and the notes "Hard · Felt strong"
Return to Interval, tap the "History" tab and verify that today's workout reads "Hard" and "Felt strong"; then tap the "Timer" tab and its "Settings" button
Tap the "Health Connect" switch and verify that it is off
Open Health Connect's app permissions and verify that Interval has no permissions left
Tap the "Settings" button on the Timer tab, then "About Interval" at the foot of the page, then "Privacy", and verify that the policy page shows
